entities.summary:
Mother Teresa University in Skopje is a public university based in Skopje, North Macedonia. Studies in this institution are conducted in Albanian and Macedonian. The university was founded in 2016 with the mission of creating academic opportunities for students to develop as individuals and professionals. It offers education in both natural and social sciences through its five faculties.

These faculties cover a variety of disciplines, including computer science, applied programming, etc. Despite its young age, the university has grown to over 3,500 students and offers a variety of undergraduate and graduate programs. Mother Teresa University in Skopje is a university in Europe, established in 2016-10-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
